name: Sync init template with current prompt.md; make README install instructions true
description: Two public-credential issues from the 2026-07-05 external review. (1) The PROMPT_TEMPLATE embedded in fade-cli (used by fade init) is an old version missing acPassed checkpointing, the Observability section, PRD Integrity Rules, and the standards routing table — new projects get worse instructions than FADE gives itself. (2) README says npm install -g fade-dev but the package is not published: npx fade-dev 404s. Also status.json advertises 382 passing tests while the runner (pre-fix) executed 13.

userStories.title: fade init emits the current prompt.md
userStories.description: The template written by fade init must match the protocol FADE itself runs.
acceptanceCriteria: PROMPT_TEMPLATE in fade-cli is generated from or byte-identical to fade/prompt.md sections: completion tokens, acPassed checkpointing, Observability, PRD Integrity Rules, standards routing
A guard test fails if the two drift again
fade init in a scratch directory produces a prompt.md containing the acPassed protocol

userStories.title: README install instructions are true
userStories.description: Either publish fade-dev to npm or change the README to the git/manual install as primary.
acceptanceCriteria: Following the README's first install path on a clean machine succeeds
If npm publish is chosen: npx fade-dev init works; if not: all npm references removed or marked 'coming soon'
status.json test counts reflect what the runner actually executes

technicalNotes.rationale: Documentation and template hygiene; publish decision is the owner's, PRD covers both branches.
